en: Maison is feminine, so petit adds an -e.
Chat is masculine and singular, so noir does not change.
Chiens is masculine and plural, so petit adds an -s.
Fleurs is feminine and plural, so vert adds -es.
Colours go after the noun, and rouge already ends in -e.
Voiture is feminine, so bleu adds -e, and the colour comes after.
Yeux is plural, so vert adds -s, and the colour comes after.
Blanc has a special feminine form: blanche.
Fille is feminine, so grand adds an -e.
Garçons is masculine and plural, so grand adds an -s.
Rouge already ends in -e, so it does not add another one for a feminine noun.
Souris is feminine and here it is plural, so gris becomes grises.
Chien is masculine and singular, so petit does not change.
Les filles is feminine plural, so content adds -es.
Les garçons is masculine plural, so content adds -s.
Ma mère is feminine and singular, so grand adds -e.
Mon père is masculine and singular, so petit does not change.
What do you add to most adjectives for a feminine noun?
Most adjectives add -e for a feminine noun: petit, petite.
What do you add to most adjectives for a masculine plural noun?
What do you add to most adjectives for a feminine plural noun?
For feminine plural, add -e and -s: petites.
Where do colours usually go in French?
Colours follow the noun: un chat noir.
How do you say ’a green apple’?
Pomme is feminine, so vert becomes verte, after the noun.
Chats is masculine plural, so noir adds -s, after the noun.
How do you say ’a small table’?
Table is feminine, so we use une and petite.
Jupe is feminine and singular, so bleu adds -e.
Crayons is masculine plural, so bleu adds -s.
Chaussures is feminine plural, so noir adds -es.
Le ciel is masculine and singular, so gris stays the same.
La neige is feminine, so blanc becomes blanche.
Le serpent is masculine and singular, so vert does not change.

en.title: Adjective agreement
en.teach: Adjectives change to match the noun: add -e for feminine and -s for plural. Most colours come after the noun: un petit chat, une petite souris, des chats noirs.
